digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge git delivery and push transport
propositions: Bridge git delivery abandons after a single transient transport fault (TLS/DNS/timeout) without retrying, leaving unpushed commits and silently losing converged work
The push.py retry logic classifies all non-fast-forward failures identically, treating both permanent policy violations and transient transport faults as terminal on first attempt

Transient transport faults like 'server certificate verification failed' and promisor remote fetch failures during merge recovery receive zero retries, while policy declines should remain strictly terminal

The transport retry mechanism must distinguish retriable transport errors from non-retriable policy violations using a subtractive classifier, with a bounded budget of 3 attempts per leg and exponential backoff (0.5s then 2.0s)

Both the explicit fetch in merge recovery and the on-demand promisor fetch during git merge itself must apply the same transport classifier to enable retry on transient failures while preserving terminal merge conflict handling
